source_caption_text:
Baby Jane made “Starry Eyed” sound like a forgotten 2010s classic 🤒🔥

“Starry Eyed” has a distinctly nostalgic 2010s feel, especially in its trance-pop production and synth-driven sound. The combination of electronic rhythms, atmospheric melodies, and Baby Jane’s vocals gives the track the kind of polished, emotional club-pop sound that was prominent throughout the decade.
